evidence_so_far: All candidates either optimized or screened by declared rule versus candidate_13.
Highest-activity candidate_04 is not industrial choice; parity requires 201.223x intrinsic activity increase.
Reachability on frozen descriptor manifold: maximum reference gain 1.0899x, maximum across process states 2.5246x, so 201.223x is unreachable.
Free cost breakdowns collected for candidate_04 and candidate_05.
llm_state_before.updated_belief: Decision is stable by formal stopping rule. Remaining 7 CU cannot afford model-validity checks or MC uncertainty; it could afford only zero-cost breakdowns for already optimized candidates or low-value actions. No affordable action has meaningful expected decision value for changing the industrial decision.

screened_candidates.rule: lower reference activity AND higher metal price than current lowest-cost candidate_13

evidence_supporting_decision: Full process window of 14136 states optimized for decision-critical candidates.
candidate_13 is feasible and lowest among optimized/non-screened candidates at 15.2917 USD/t.
candidate_04 and candidate_05 are feasible but costlier at 22.0306 and 25.8318 USD/t.
All other candidates are screened by lower activity and higher metal price relative to candidate_13.

Highest atomic activity candidate_04 would require a 201.223x activity increase for parity; frozen descriptor manifold provides at most 2.5246x across process states, so parity by intrinsic activity alone is unreachable.

chosen_args.why_stop: Stopping rule satisfied: S1 feasible current lowest-cost candidate identified; S2 no unresolved candidate remains because every candidate is optimized or screened by the declared rule; S3 highest-activity parity and reachability classified. Remaining budget cannot afford MC or model-validity checks, and no affordable action has meaningful expected decision value.
